claim_label: Security and liability impacts of open-source model weights
description: This conflict addresses whether releasing open-source model weights improves security through decentralized collaboration. Opponents argue instead that it primarily serves to externalize corporate liability and shift legal risks to downstream developers.

instances.assertion: Publishing model weights secures software via the Many Eyes Theory, allowing a global network of decentralized engineers to identify and patch vulnerabilities faster than closed systems.
Tech giants routinely release open-weight models as a corporate distraction to externalize their liability and force downstream developers to take the legal fall for systemic biases.
